fields.statement: At 2a7a01a1: go test -trimpath ./internal/rootcfg/... passes, including TestFindEmptyDirFindsNoRoot, which chdirs into a subfolder of a rhiza.toml root and asserts Find("") reports no root (and Find(".") still finds it). go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... -run Usage passes, including TestUsageLearnEmptyWdStaysInRepoFolder: Ctx.Wd empty, cwd under an enclosing root, recordLimitHit writes one hit to the repo's daemon folder and none under the root (RootStateDir not even created). In a scratch worktree with the old rootcfg.go both tests fail, so they cover the fix. Diff read: Find returns false for an empty dir; cmd/rhiza newCtx still sets Ctx.Wd from os.Getwd (absolute), and TUI projectctx callers pass os.Getwd. go vet and gofmt clean on both packages.
